name: @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation-monorepo
description: AI Conversation plugin packages for Backstage, powered by LiteLLM RAG. Designed for use within Backstage monorepo.

scripts.build: yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation build && yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation-backend build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation test --watch=false && yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation-backend test --watch=false
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation lint && yarn workspace @acarmisc/backstage-plugin-ai-conversation-backend lint
